name: 10019 · New York, NY
findings: ZIP 10019 (New York) has 841 nonprofit organizations. 307 of them (37%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 265 organizations.
Foundation organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (21% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 10019 (New York) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
